photos.file: File:Veduta esterna Museo casa Enzo Ferrari.jpg

commons_category: Category:Exterior of the Museo Enzo Ferrari, Modena
note: First photo: full curved glass facade with yellow roof (small photographer signature in a corner). Others: facade beside the old workshop, roof from the side, facade detail.

Only 1600px for the two wide views (nothing larger shows the whole complex). First: stepped concrete residence blocks seen up a garden stair; second: terraced blocks from above; then two black-and-white details of concrete stairs and brick. Descriptions all say Collegio del Colle.
The category holds only the Paolo Monti photo already tried; searches for Saracena / 'Villa detta la Saracena' / Saracena Moretti find nothing else on Commons.

No clear photo of Scarpa's facade on Commons. Category:Banca Popolare di Verona only has branch offices elsewhere; Piazza Nogara photos show the facade with its round windows only small and behind parked cars (best of these: File:Piazza Nogara (1).jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0, a distant fallback).
The category holds only the three tried 'Vietri sul mare' files; searches for Solimene, Soleri + Vietri and the factory find nothing else on Commons.

Only the two tried Paolo Monti 1965 photos exist; the related category 'Campania - Pozzuoli - Stabilimento Olivetti - Villaggio Olivetti' is empty and searches (Olivetti Pozzuoli, Cosenza stabilimento) find nothing else.

photos.file: File:Vue Athènes depuis Colline Lycabette - Athènes (GRA1) - 2022-03-26 - 19.jpg

note: Every free photo is taken from the summit of Lycabettus looking down, so the theatre is never a close-up. These three show it most clearly: the curved red-and-yellow seating set into the quarry rock, centred and filling about a third of the frame. Consider cropping to the theatre. A tighter shot (File:Lycabettus Theatre.jpg) exists but is GFDL only, so it was skipped.
No Commons category. Category:Vesima has only the tried detail and a 1006px beach view where the glass workshop is a tiny speck on the hillside; nothing shows the stepped glass roof clearly.
The only Commons file is the tried 'House Before House 2009.jpg' (in Category:Sou Fujimoto); title and full-text searches find nothing else.

First: the Opera House front from Nambu Beltway, centred: round drum with the gat-shaped roof and arched entrance (street traffic in the lower third; crop from the top). Second: the roof edge rising over the garden terraces (1600px). Most other files in the category are concerts, interiors or vending machines.

Weak: the only exterior close-up is a night shot of the ACC's long facade block over its glass base, lit red by the light artwork '#include red' (GRAYCODE, jiiiiin, 2017), 2112px. It shows the building's form but reads as an art piece; the owner may prefer to treat this as 'none'. Everything else in the category is meetings, performances or the tried aerial panorama.

photos.file: File:Stupy w murze klasztoru Erdene Dzuu 02.jpg
File:Klasztor Erdene Dzuu widziany ze szczytu wzniesienia.jpg

note: First: the enclosure wall with its white stupas under blue sky. Then the Zuu temples on their raised platform, temple pavilions in the courtyard, and the whole square stupa-wall enclosure seen from the hill above.

First: the main two-storey temple (Tsogchin) close up on its stone platform. Then the whole walled, symmetrical complex in the valley from the hillside, a temple front on axis down the path, and the long red wall in open steppe.

photos.file: File:Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue, photo by Vaiz Ha.jpg

commons_category: Category:Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue, Tsonjin Boldog
note: Commons category exists (the building had none recorded): Category:Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue, Tsonjin Boldog. First: the steel horseman on the round colonnaded visitor-centre drum, whole and centred. Then the approach stair on axis, a wider view with clouds (CC0), and a close-up of the rider from the viewing platform.

The category holds only the tried park views and close-ups of the eternal flame under the gate. Category:Seoul Olympic Park (about 80 files) has nothing better: the gate appears only small and partly hidden behind trees in File:Entrance of the Seoul Olympic Park.jpg.

photos.file: File:Puente de la Mujer in Puerto Madero.jpg
File:Puente de la Mujer - Puerto Madero - Buenos Aires - Argentina.jpg

note: First: the white mast and cable-stayed deck close up from the dock, whole bridge in frame. Then the bridge at golden hour against the Puerto Madero towers, a side view under clouds, and an upward detail of the mast and cables.

Category:United Arab Emirates Pavilion at EXPO 2020 is mis-filled: all 32 files are 'Pavilhão Emirates', the Emirates airline pavilion (interiors, delegations), not Calatrava's falcon-wing UAE Pavilion. Searches ('UAE Pavilion', Calatrava Expo 2020, Expo 2020 pavilion categories, a sample of the untagged Expo 2020 Flickr sets) found no photo of the Calatrava building.

Apart from the three tried files, Commons has only: views out from the deck, the glass floor, a 540px crop, a construction shot of the two bare cores, a skyline where the frame is a tiny outline (File:Dubai Frame & Sheik Zayed Road.jpg) and a park shot without the frame. Nothing new shows the frame clearly.
No Commons category. Searches for Al Bahr / Al Bahar Towers, Aedas Abu Dhabi and Abu Dhabi Investment Council find only the tried 'Fountain and Al Bahr Towers - panoramio.jpg'.

photos.file: File:New Year Countdown on One Zabeel Building.jpg

note: Only one usable file (not in the category; found by title search 'Zabeel'): a night view of the two towers lit with a New Year countdown, with The Link bridge glowing blue between them, centred among neighbouring towers. Readable, but a night shot. No daytime view on Commons.

commons_category: Category:Sheikh Jaber Al Ahmad Cultural Centre
note: The category holds only the tried photo, a 490px image (Jacckuwait.jpg, too small) and a stage photo of an opera singer. English and Arabic searches find nothing else.

First: Melnikov's curved drum front with its glazed bays and the twin external stairs, whole building across the street under clear sky. Then the same front in spring, the side wing and drum from the corner, and a close frontal view of the drum in low sun (overhead wires cross the last one).

First: the two white shell-shaped farewell halls from above, the big arched shell with its ribbed glazed band and the pointed shell beside it (1800px, the clearest view). Then the shells from across the cemetery, both shells framed by leaves (6720px), and the complex in its wooded ravine with the city behind.
